channel.title: Leenus Darnal — Notes
channel.description: Personal notes on small tools, software and things worth keeping.

item.title: Show the parts behind the estimate
item.description: The salary calculator separates gross pay, deductions and estimated in-hand pay so the estimate can be reviewed component by component.

item.title: Make a small tool easy to open
item.description: The salary calculator is kept in one HTML file with its styles and scripts, making it easy to open and inspect.
